characterization.accounting_note: A recast of comparative periods to follow a new presentation is a reclassification disclosure, not a restatement of previously issued financial statements; it does not by itself indicate an error, and no Form 10-K/A was filed for FY2023
characterization.method: Item 9C checkbox state plus recast disclosures read from both primary documents at run time; no classification is typed in

recast_disclosures: In the first quarter of 2024, we reclassified royalty income (substantially all of which is related to our Biopharma segment) from Other (income)/deductions––net and began presenting Royalty revenues as a separate line item within Total revenues in our consolidated statements of operations
Prior-period amounts have been recast to conform to the current presentation

We have made certain reclassification adjustments to conform prior-period amounts to the current presentation for: • in the first quarter of 2024, we reclassified royalty income (substantially all of which is related to Biopharma) from Other (income)/deductions––net and began presenting Royalty revenues as a separate line item within Total revenues in our consolidated statements of operations, and reclassified the associated royalty receivables from Other current assets to Trade accounts receivable, less allowance for doubtful accounts in our consolidated balance sheet; and • segment reporting and geographic information in connection with the commercial reorganization that went into effect on January 1, 2024 (see Notes 9 and 1 7 )

2023 Form 10-K 31 While royalty income through December 31, 2023 has been recorded in Other Income/(Deductions)—net , we will begin reporting such royalty income in Total revenues beginning in 2024 and will restate prior periods for consistency with our 2024 presentation
(a) Beginning in 2024, we will include royalty income in Total revenues and will restate prior periods for consistency with our 2024 presentation

characterization.what_changed: beginning in 2024 Pfizer presents royalty income within Total revenues instead of Other (income)/deductions--net, and recast prior-period comparatives to follow; the FY2023 comparative therefore exceeds the FY2023 as-filed figure by the reclassified royalty amount
characterization.what_it_is_not: not an error correction, not a restatement under ASC 250, not a Form 10-K/A, not an enforcement action, and not evidence about Pfizer's performance

double_count_guard.purpose: re-offering a revision published before the decision clock

not_yet_public.purpose: an audit run before the restatement was accepted

limitations: one reclassification of one line; no portfolio-level conclusion follows
the revenue-to-coefficient mapping is declared, not estimated
the second and third lines of the model are illustrative parameters
a comparative-column recast is not an enforcement action or a fraud finding
the revised figure is not an independent measurement of the same quantity: it includes royalty income the as-filed figure excluded, so the difference is a change in presentation as well as in amount
the characterisation rests on two documents and their Item 9C checkboxes; it does not audit Pfizer's accounting

model.disclaimer: the risk matrix, the other two coefficients and the budget are model parameters; only the first coefficient is evidence-linked

labels.assumption: revenue maps linearly to the objective coefficient at 1/1000

compiled_revision.note: FY2023 revenue as recast in the FY2024 annual report's comparative column after royalty income was reclassified into Total revenues, replacing the figure first filed in the FY2023 annual report; the model input is the implied growth rate against FY2022. A conforming recast, not an error correction

declared_sensitivity.note: declared: the objective minimises -growth*0.1 on the first line
